name: productos
description: ProductOS — a complete operating system for taking a product from idea to revenue with AI agents. Installs inside your app repo as productos/, optionally ships with a coach-composed programme plan, and runs four phases (Define, Design, Develop, Distribute), each with checklists, templates, and 36 skills that fill them in.

interface.shortDescription: From idea to revenue with AI agents
interface.longDescription: ProductOS guides you through four phases — Define, Design, Develop, Distribute — each with checklists, templates, and skills that fill them in. Your AI agent does the heavy lifting; the system keeps it honest, closing every phase with a launch that climbs the signal ladder from first reply to first payment.
defaultPrompt: Set up ProductOS in my repo
Help me build my product offer
